attacks.name: XSE Blaster
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, if the defender is within |!range| 3, it gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Return With Interest
steps: When this attack is chosen, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical|, |!energy|, or |!mystic|.
During the |*Pay| |!power| |*Cost| step of the attack, this character may spend up to 3 additional |!power|. Add 1 die to each attack for each |!power| spent in this way.
|!wild| |*Extreme Force|: After each attack is resolved, this character Pushes the defender Away |!movement_small|. Then the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.

superPowers.name: Absorbed Energy Conversion
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or enemy character, both of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!movement_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Mutant Energy Absorption
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an attack, for each |!wild| in the defense roll, it may change 1 of the attacker's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!hit| results to a Blank. This character gains 1 |!power| for each die changed this way.

superPowers.name: Overload
superPowers.body: During the |*Cleanup Phase|, if this character has 8 or more |!power|, it suffers 1 |!damage|.
